text: {"sql":"SELECT c.level AS 会员等级, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价, SUM(oi.amount) AS 已完成销售额, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 去重订单数 FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY c.level ORDER BY c.level","unanswerable":false,"unanswerableReason":""}
